{{Quote|For a moment, dead comrades and missing limbs are forgotten, as g-force slams them without touching their weightless spirits. This is triumph.|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]|<ref name="Empire 12">[[Empire 12|''Empire'' 12]]</ref>}}
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] '''struck''' at an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] facility and stole several [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] for use by the Rebels at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Some have you may have seen X-wings. They're good ships.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]|<ref name="Empire 12" />}}
The objective of the mission was to collect X-wings for the pilots of the [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] [[Great Temple/Legends|base]]. The attack plan was devised by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|We want them to think we're alone. Then we lead them on a merry chase. Once they're drawn away, the ''Rand'' shows up, and picks up the X-wings.|Biggs Darklighter|<ref name="Empire 12" />}}
[[File:Biggs_blaster_in_space.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] shoots a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] from space.]]

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] led a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] that had recently defected, to strike the base. The use of TIE fitted with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] surprised the Imperials and let them time to leave the planet. All the TIE fighters of the base, piloted by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] members, quickly took off to intercept the Rebel TIEs.

While TIE fighters were pursuing other TIEs in space, a group of Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spies]] infiltrated in the facility neutralized all Imperial guards.

[[File:XwingTheft-SWEMP12.jpg|thumb|200px|[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilots steal [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from the Incom facility.]]

The Rebel TIEs were modified in order to be controlled by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. The four former Imperial pilots discretely ejected from their fighters and let the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] take over the TIEs and lead the Imperial fighters in a chase to the edge of the system. A Rebel [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|transport]] escorted by two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] soon arrived in the system to recover the pilots who could survive in space thanks to their [[TIE pilot]] [[Environment suit/Legends|space suit]]. A Y-wing was shot down by an isolated Imperial fighter but Biggs managed to destroy it with his [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifle]]. The pilot were then collected by the transport.

Bigg's pilots and several other [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]], including [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], eventually landed at the facility on the transport and seized two dozen X-wings without any resistance. They then brought them back to the Yavin 4 base in the [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']] because the X-wings were unable to navigate through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] without astromech droids.

==Aftermath==
[[File:Hobbie-diseased.jpg|thumb|left|160px|An infected [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Klivian]] after the mission.]]

{{Quote|Why can you fly the X-wings home? They have hyperdrive.''"<br />"''They do, but you need an R2 unit to navigate hyperspace. Don't have them yet.|A Rebel and Biggs Darklighter|<ref name="Empire 12" />}}
The mission was successful, however Peate Kurin died while ejecting, and Hobbie's right shin and foot were cut off. He was to be given a replacement, but the injury became infected. This prevented him from flying for quite some time and kept him grounded for the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

As a result of the mission, Yavin Base now had X-wing starfighters, albeit without the astromechs necessary to navigate in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. A [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|mission]] was quickly organized to recover some [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 astro droids]] from [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Nera Dantels]] on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].
